description: The snipers of a Solana token (pump.fun and other launches): the wallets besides the dev that bought in the block it launched or the few right after, and what kind each is. Tied to the dev: funded by the dev or by the wallet that funded the dev, or the dev paid for its buy (the dev taking supply under other names). Sniping bot: buys many different new tokens within seconds of launch (8 or more in its last 40 transactions), unrelated to the dev, usually selling within minutes. For each: share bought and held now, the Jito tip and fee it paid to land there, who funded it, whether it's a new wallet, and its recent trading. Use for 'who sniped this?', 'were the snipers the dev?', 'is this an insider launch or just bots?'. bundle_check covers everyone in the first minute. Facts, not an accusation. Premium: 2¢ a call from prepaid agent credits (3 free premium calls a day). Send your agent key as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

blocks.description: Blocks after the launch block to include. Default 2 (about a second), max 20
